entries.reason: LongbridgeBroker.spec.ts:1-45 mocks numeric enums and promise-returning contexts only, so a resolved mock cannot prove remote acceptance or native envelope/version semantics. The repaired entry now requires a version-tagged codec, an independent ledger, and a crash cut; until conformance exists, unknown envelope/version is ProtocolViolation/RecoveryRequired and accepted-before-ack is Unknown/Observe, not redispatch.

LongbridgeBroker.spec.ts:47-82 injects structurally incomplete private contexts and literal credentials, bypassing init. The target now requires a scoped Layer, explicit RuntimeHealth/generation, no pre-ready SDK call, and redacted credential diagnostics.

LongbridgeBroker.spec.ts:84-168 intentionally accepts bare TSLA, currency inference, and always-STK projections even though Longbridge contracts.ts:4-6 declares suffix identity. The design removes bare/ CNY guesses and admits only catalog-correlated InstrumentId evidence.

LongbridgeBroker.spec.ts:170-201 proves HK MKT→ELO, US MKT→MO, LO/MIT/LIT and TSMPCT, but the mapper has no unit/protection context. The final compiler preserves these source mappings and excludes unsupported amount/notional/protection variants from each leaf input schema while reporting availability separately; it never silently drops them or imposes a global order union.

LongbridgeBroker.spec.ts:203-223 and LongbridgeBroker.ts:103-120 show unknown TIF→Day, GTD without expiry, and null IOC/FOK/OPG. The final TIF leaf admits only declared variants; it retains GoodTill only with expiry evidence, keeps unsupported variants as separate availability facts, and rejects unknown or expiry-less input before the SDK.

LongbridgeBroker.spec.ts:225-233 covers only a few status numbers while contracts.ts:113-135 defaults unknown to Submitted and collapses rejection/expiry/partial states. The repaired codec keeps unknown raw status with RecoveryRequired and prevents a Submitted projection.

LongbridgeBroker.spec.ts:235-275 proves only trade accountBalance probing and message-regex auth retries, not native error code/status mapping or quote coverage. The reviewed entry now records per-endpoint ProbeFacts and keeps unknown codes or unprobed quote reach non-Ready/Unavailable with write admission closed until pack conformance.

LongbridgeBroker.spec.ts:277-336 proves HKD/largest-bucket selection, empty zeros, and stub FX folding. The repaired model preserves every currency bucket as AccountObservation, exposes compatibility only as an explicitly degraded view, and marks no-FX/stale/empty valuation non-executable instead of presenting one bucket as total.

LongbridgeBroker.spec.ts:340-378 shows channels flattened and zero rows omitted. The entry now preserves raw accountChannel plus resolved scope, records zero as closing evidence, and rejects scope ambiguity instead of merging symbols.

LongbridgeBroker.spec.ts:380-391 verifies -100→short/100, while the old projection discarded signed quantity. The review keeps signed native evidence and corrects the boundary case: Decimal -0 is valid Flat zero; only malformed/nonfinite values fail.

LongbridgeBroker.spec.ts:393-427 explicitly expects quote failure to use costPrice as current mark. The repaired observation model removes that fallback, keeps cost basis displayable, and permits Exact valuation only from a quality-stamped mark.

LongbridgeBroker.spec.ts:429-475 proves option multiplier 100 and warrant ratio 0.1 affect value/PnL, while missing maps default one in LongbridgeBroker.ts:511-526. The entry requires positive, instrument-bound multiplier evidence and retains EquityLike ambiguity until kind is corroborated.

LongbridgeBroker.spec.ts:477-505 proves mixed stock/option arithmetic but not response ordering or symbol collision safety. The repaired batch join keys rows by canonical InstrumentId+scope and lets one failed option enrichment leave an unrelated stock exact.

LongbridgeBroker.spec.ts:507-522 expects staticInfo failure to value an option-like row as equity with multiplier one. The review rejects that unsafe coercion, preserves the live mark as incomplete evidence, and schedules metadata recovery.

LongbridgeBroker.spec.ts:524-529 only checks a text BrokerError for stockPositions failure. The entry now distinguishes transport/protocol/scope failures, preserves a prior projection as stale when available, and never turns failed reads into an empty position set.

LongbridgeBroker.spec.ts:534-570 observes direct submit and a synthetic New result; `_tpsl` is unused in LongbridgeBroker.ts:271-312. The final placement leaf preserves only declared protection/relation variants, rejects omitted ones rather than sending entry-only intent, and adds approval-gated WAL/CAS/idempotency/observe semantics only through the optional transaction wrapper.

LongbridgeBroker.spec.ts:572-598 proves refusal before submit only through string errors. The repaired entry distinguishes invalid identity, unsupported capability, and idempotency conflict, with a durable PrepareRejected receipt but no EffectJob/dispatch artifact.

LongbridgeBroker.spec.ts:600-627 checks IOC and nonpositive quantity only; the implementation lacks lot/precision/unit checks and unknown TIF safety. The final validation is a specific-leaf schema/HOF composition: omitted sizing or TIF variants fail at the schema boundary, availability stays separate, and no global Units/Notional restriction is assumed.

LongbridgeBroker.spec.ts:629-646 proves LO/Sell and Decimal 305.5, while placeOrder passes an unchecked cast and permits missing/sentinel limit fields. The repaired entry validates currency/tick/Decimal and rejects an unset LMT price before an executable job.

LongbridgeBroker.spec.ts:648-662 surfaces only a free-form insufficient-buying-power message. The review does not treat that text as conclusive rejection: provider-coded rejection may follow policy, but any post-DispatchStarted unclassified exception is Unknown and pauses forward work.

LongbridgeBroker.spec.ts:667-685 and cancelOrder:337-343 synthesize terminal Cancelled on an SDK promise and stringify errors. The repaired action carries scope/version/criterion, treats Ack as reconciling, and observes filled/cancelled/unknown outcomes.

LongbridgeBroker.spec.ts:687-706 requires totalQuantity and sends 150, but Partial<Order> omits unchanged fields/version and the implementation returns Replaced on any resolved promise. The entry now requires a complete replacement, before-image/version CAS, and post-ack observation.

LongbridgeBroker.spec.ts:710-734 validates only first quote/depth values; getQuote takes the first response without identity/schema checks. The repaired MarketObservation validates expected symbol, freshness and side quality, including one-sided books.

LongbridgeBroker.spec.ts:736-755 documents rejected depth becoming numeric bid/ask zero. The review removes this invented liquidity and distinguishes Present, EmptyBook, BidOnly, AskOnly and Unavailable.

LongbridgeBroker.spec.ts:760-774 treats any all-day HK session as an account-wide open bool. The repaired query is venue/scope keyed and treats empty session coverage as Unknown rather than Closed, with explicit boundaries and freshness.

LongbridgeBroker.spec.ts:776-798 monkey-patches local Date hours/minutes to test a closed interval; isWithinSession ignores seconds/timezone/holidays. The entry moves evaluation to explicit Instant plus venue calendar and endpoint policy.

LongbridgeBroker.spec.ts:803-810 asserts a static STK/order string list, and getCapabilities:676-681 varies with no context. The repaired capability ADT is scope/permission/session/reach/SDK-fingerprint keyed and refuses unproven derivatives or mutations.

LongbridgeBroker.spec.ts:812-816 proves only 700.HK round-trip, while getNativeKey:685-688 falls back to display symbol or empty. The review uses a branded, scope-bound native key and rejects empty/display fallback.

LongbridgeBroker.spec.ts:818-823 only checks AAPL.US projection, but resolveNativeKey:690-692 feeds arbitrary strings to permissive makeContract. The repaired resolver retains validated suffix evidence and marks legacy ambiguous keys operator-required.

LongbridgeBroker.spec.ts:828-843 uses a toString-only Decimal helper and defaults every omitted balance field to zero. The reviewed fixtures now require observed SDK schema/version plus an independent remote ledger; absent either, Missing remains distinct from Zero and crash/remote outcomes stay ProtocolViolation or Unknown/Observe.

LongbridgeBroker.ts:18-69 combines IBKR facade, Longbridge SDK, mutable state and unchecked casts. The final adapter may depend on SDK types through the domain SPI, while the kernel and UTA-facing domain core import none; native decoding stays behind typed, serializable ports without SDK objects/effects/secrets crossing the boundary.

LongbridgeBroker.ts:71-101 maps known market/stop/trailing tags but returns raw enum/null with no sizing, protection or relation semantics. The final compiler preserves exact proven tags and lets each Longbridge leaf declare its own sizing/trailing/protection variants; unsupported variants are absent from that leaf schema with separate availability, not a global Units/Notional rule.

LongbridgeBroker.ts:103-121 defaults unknown TIF to Day and maps GTD without expiry. The final TIF leaf admits only declared variants, treats empty as migration evidence, requires expiry-bearing GoodTill, and records IOC/FOK/OPG as unavailable rather than accepting those inputs or defaulting them.

LongbridgeBroker.ts:125-151 validates raw credential strings, defaults paper false, and accepts optional endpoints without environment/account proof; longbridge-types.ts:17-31 documents only a paper marker and matching credentials. The repair retains EnvironmentUnknown/no-write until pack evidence links paper/live intent to observed endpoint/account, persists CredentialRef only, and rejects explicit mismatch.

LongbridgeBroker.ts:153-172 stores uninitialized contexts and a mutable optional FxService setter. The reviewed target makes identity/generation/FX observations immutable, separates C06 health from reach, and invalidates old plans on reconnect/provider changes.

LongbridgeBroker.ts:174-228 performs one accountBalance probe with five sleeps, message-regex auth detection and raw lastErr. The correction adds per-endpoint ProbeFacts and typed UnclassifiedNativeFailure/ProbeCoverageUnknown; no unknown code/status or missing coverage can establish RuntimeHealth.Ready or admission before empirical conformance.

LongbridgeBroker.ts:230-233 implements close as an async no-op because Rust handles rely on GC, so the source directly resolves that no explicit release API exists. The reviewed design uses scoped finalization, closed-generation evidence and CleanupEvidenceUnavailable without claiming deterministic native release; closing one generation does not force unrelated accounts or global RuntimeHealth Stopping/Failed, and whole-process shutdown remains a separate coordinator path.

LongbridgeBroker.ts:235-244 returns [] only for empty search and otherwise echoes a guessed symbol/default US ContractDescription. The review adds Complete/Partial/Unavailable/NoMatch/Ambiguous catalog states and requires complete scoped evidence for placement.

LongbridgeBroker.ts:246-267 uses infos[0], `lotSize || 1`, hardcoded MKT/LMT/STP details and null for every error. The repaired entry requires response identity/positive lot correlation, keeps derivative kind incomplete when this path cannot prove it, and returns typed lookup states.

LongbridgeBroker.ts:269-313 sends SubmitOrderOptions immediately, casts Decimal values, stringifies errors and ignores `_tpsl`. The repaired plan preserves a non-executable Draft/Prepared phase, requires approval before reservation/job, and separates Ack from observed confirmation while refusing unexpressible protection/relations.

LongbridgeBroker.ts:315-335 accepts Partial<Order>, requires quantity by convention, and reports Replaced on resolved replaceOrder. The correction makes unchanged fields explicit, binds before-image/version/compensation, and reconciles unknown replacement outcomes.

LongbridgeBroker.ts:337-344 sends a bare string order id and returns synthetic Canceled on Ack. The reviewed action retains scoped native identity and cancel criterion, then observes cancellation versus fill/working/unknown.

LongbridgeBroker.ts:346-362 reads a projected position and recursively submits a reverse DAY MKT order, allowing race/oversize and no exact rollback. The repaired ClosePosition carries signed exposure before-image, ExposureEquals, lock and residual recovery criterion.

LongbridgeBroker.ts:364-372 returns foldBalancesToBase without await inside try, so async FX failures escape BrokerError.from. The entry makes the boundary await/decode raw buckets first and returns typed Unknown valuation without deleting durable facts.

LongbridgeBroker.ts:381-409 selects HKD or the largest netAssets bucket and zeros empty accounts. The correction preserves every currency bucket, renders compatibility only as explicitly degraded without inventing a numeric total, and represents no-FX/empty as UnknownValuation/EmptyObserved rather than an executable base total.

LongbridgeBroker.ts:411-435 converts buckets to HKD but discards rate/source evidence and hardcodes unrealizedPnL=0. The repaired accounting fold retains FX observations and derives PnL from fills/marks, leaving unavailable PnL Unknown.

LongbridgeBroker.ts:437-447 divides one-unit USD conversions, while fx-service.ts:140-204 can return stale/default and unknown-currency 1:1 values with only a warning. The review preserves both rate observations and makes default/unknown cross-currency results non-executable.

LongbridgeBroker.ts:449-509 drops zero rows, deduplicates raw symbols, swallows enrichment errors and treats missing static metadata as equity. The repaired pipeline keys canonical scoped rows, preserves EmptyObserved/zero evidence, and records per-row enrichment status/retry.

LongbridgeBroker.ts:511-541 always builds STK, uses cost as mark, defaults multiplier one and writes realizedPnL=0. The review moves valuation/PnL to typed accounting observations and permits only evidence-backed Exact values.

LongbridgeBroker.ts:543-557 catches every quote batch error into an empty map, after which buildPosition uses costPrice. The final keyed result preserves per-instrument Live/Stale/NoQuote/Unavailable evidence and never substitutes cost as current mark; retries remain observation work, not order jobs.

LongbridgeBroker.ts:559-575 catches staticInfo failure into an empty map and line 567 uses `stockDerivatives ?? []`, conflating missing with explicit empty and then treating both as equity. The correction keeps Unresolved versus EquityLike and blocks exact derivative decisions.

LongbridgeBroker.ts:577-593 leaves option multiplier absent on failure and buildPosition defaults it to one. The reviewed model requires a positive InstrumentId-bound observation, durable retry and incomplete valuation on absence.

LongbridgeBroker.ts:595-611 leaves warrant conversionRatio absent on failure and defaults one. The repair preserves issuer/ratio evidence, requires positive ratio for Exact value, and treats even ratio 1 as unproven without native evidence.

LongbridgeBroker.ts:613-620 drops null results from requested-id queries. The corrected model returns one Found/NotFound/Unavailable/Unknown per ScopedOrderRef, separates requested-set completeness from true listing namespace/cursor completeness, and schedules observation for Unknown.

LongbridgeBroker.ts:622-629 catches transport, permission, malformed and not-found orderDetail errors as null. The review decodes native identity/status and classifies only conclusive absence as NotFound; post-dispatch null-equivalent evidence is Unknown.

LongbridgeBroker.ts:631-657 takes first quote/depth values and converts depth rejection to empty arrays/zero bid-ask. The repaired codecs correlate symbol, preserve source/time/session, and expose EmptyBook/one-sided/Unavailable quality.

LongbridgeBroker.ts:659-672 compares all sessions against machine-local Date and returns one isOpen bool; empty `?? []` becomes false. The correction keys observations by venue/session, supplies calendar/timezone evidence, and maps empty/failed coverage to Unknown.

LongbridgeBroker.ts:674-681 returns the same STK/five-order list for every context. The repaired capability set separates authorization, provider support, session, reach, idempotency and compensation and fingerprints evidence for reprepare.

LongbridgeBroker.ts:683-692 uses resolved string/contract.symbol and reconstructs any native key through permissive makeContract. The reviewed identity codec validates suffix/venue/currency/kind, binds scope, and refuses legacy ambiguity.

LongbridgeBroker.ts:694-714 makes STK and mutable Order, writes orderId=0, ignores executedQuantity/version and defaults unknown native types. The final observation retains native id/fills/version and raw unknown enum/version evidence; compatibility is deliberately lossy and never fabricates type/TIF or dispatch authority.

LongbridgeBroker.ts:716-734 maps known order types but defaults unknown numbers to LMT and collapses amount/percent to legacy strings. The repaired decoder retains raw/version and trailing unit, routes unknown to RecoveryRequired, and keeps display mapping lossy only at the edge.

LongbridgeBroker.ts:736-743 defaults unknown TIF numbers to DAY and LongbridgeOrderLike has no expiry field. The review retains Unknown(raw), requires expiry for GTD, and prevents a compatibility DAY projection from becoming authority.

LongbridgeBroker.ts:745-761 uses local hour/minute inclusive comparisons, ignoring seconds/timezone/holiday semantics. The corrected pure evaluator consumes explicit Instant/calendar windows with endpoint policy and next boundaries.

longbridge/index.ts:1-2 exports only the mutable LongbridgeBroker/config, so no Layer/codec/SPI composition is reachable. The final barrel plan adds explicit Layer/interpreter/codecs, reports unavailable evidence for a declared leaf, leaves unsupported leaves absent, and keeps legacy export only during controlled cutover.

longbridge-contracts.ts:9-25 contains only a loose suffix→exchange/currency table. The correction treats that table as closed venue/currency metadata, obtains jurisdiction/kind/timezone separately, and rejects unknown suffixes rather than inventing facts.

longbridge-contracts.ts:27-43 accepts bare/unknown suffixes, always emits STK and preserves the raw localSymbol. The reviewed constructor accepts only validated InstrumentId and represents derivative/ambiguous metadata explicitly.

longbridge-contracts.ts:45-57 splits at the last dot and defaults bare symbols to US without validating ticker/suffix. The correction adds closed suffix/ticker parsing and requires catalog evidence before bare input is tradeable.

longbridge-contracts.ts:59-92 lets localSymbol/aliceId/currency inference override missing corroboration, collapses CNY/CNH to SH and unknown currency to US. The repaired resolver treats aliceId as a routing/UTA reference, requires typed identity evidence, and uses currency only as corroboration; AccountScope is added only for account-owned leaves.

longbridge-contracts.ts:94-107 maps CN to SH and unknown/Crypto to US even though this helper is unused. The review removes it after decoder migration and makes unknown board/market a protocol/identity failure.

longbridge-contracts.ts:109-136 collapses statuses and defaults unknown to Submitted. The repaired status ADT retains Unknown(raw), distinguishes expiry/rejection/partial outcomes, and keeps RecoveryRequired exclusion until observation.

longbridge-contracts.ts:138-144 copies msg only for status 14 and exposes all other failures through coarse OrderState. The review keeps redacted rejection evidence only for decoded rejection and separates protocol/unavailable/unknown outcomes.

longbridge-contracts.ts:146-151 turns any search string into a ContractDescription via makeContract without existence evidence. The correction returns explicit NoMatch/Unavailable/Ambiguous states and emits descriptions only from complete validated catalog evidence.

longbridge-types.ts:9-32 defines raw secrets, paper marker and optional endpoint URLs but no endpoint/account consistency evidence. The reviewed codec requires broker-pack composition conformance, keeps missing evidence EnvironmentUnknown/no-write, rejects explicit conflict as EnvironmentMismatch, and persists only CredentialRef/fingerprint.

longbridge-types.ts:34-42 models getter-only numeric fields structurally with no runtime presence/currency/scope checks. The correction validates getter presence and Decimal/CurrencyCode, distinguishing Missing from explicit zero in AccountObservation.

longbridge-types.ts:44-57 exposes unbranded position strings/numbers and places accountChannel only on the outer response; getPositions discards it. The reviewed codec retains channel/scope/native market/signed units and rejects unknown market or malformed quantity.

longbridge-types.ts:59-74 has structural quote/depth values and nullable side prices without quality/context. The repair validates Decimal/volume/timestamps and distinguishes EmptyBook, one-sided and Unavailable depth instead of numeric zero.

longbridge-types.ts:76-90 exposes numeric order enums, optional prices, free msg and unvalidated executedQuantity. The final provider-declared leaf schema selects required fields and preserves raw unknown enum/version evidence, validates fill bounds, and keeps incomplete/unknown observations separate from absence or terminal state.

longbridge-types.ts:92-101 says Option=0/Warrant=1 but an empty stockDerivatives array is plain equity/fund and lot is unchecked. The repair uses EquityLike for explicit empty, Unresolved for missing, positive lot validation, and no unknown-tag equity fallback.

longbridge-types.ts:103-115 only provides toString-capable multiplier/ratio fields with no positivity, timestamp or instrument relation. The reviewed MultiplierObservation requires positive finite value, expected InstrumentId/kind, source/version and durable incomplete status.

longbridge-types.ts:117-125 contains numeric market/session tags and local hour-minute-second windows but no timezone/date/calendar evidence. The correction decodes known tags, supplies calendar-derived instants, and maps unknown/empty coverage to Unknown rather than false/closed.
